The /community/data-library/issues/list API provides a response in the following format:

200 Success

DataIssueListResponse Model - Response from listing data issues.
results DataIssue Array
Data issues in the requested range.
resultsFound integer
Number of issues that match the filters.
openIssuesCount integer
Number of open issues on the Data Issues page.
closedIssuesCount integer
Number of closed issues on the Data Issues page.
success boolean
Indicate if the API request was successful.
errors string Array
List of errors with the API call.
Example 
{
  "results": [
    {
      "discussionId": 0,
      "ticker": "string",
      "security": "string",
      "market": "string",
      "resolution": "string",
      "from": "2024-08-01 00:00:00",
      "to": "2024-08-02 00:00:00",
      "status": "In queue",
      "corruptedFile": 0,
      "missingPoints": 0,
      "missingFile": 0,
      "wrongValues": 0,
      "listingError": 0,
      "splitError": 0,
      "dividendError": 0,
      "mappingError": 0,
      "reported": 0,
      "subscribed": true,
      "userName": "string",
      "userPublicId": "string",
      "userProfile": "string"
    }
  ],
  "resultsFound": 0,
  "openIssuesCount": 0,
  "closedIssuesCount": 0,
  "success": true,
  "errors": [
    "string"
  ]
}
DataIssue Model - An issue reported on the Data Issues page.
discussionId integer
Id of the data issue. The issue page is https://www.quantconnect.com/datasets/issue/{discussionId}.
ticker string
Ticker of the security with the issue.
security string
Asset class of the dataset.
market string
Market of the dataset.
resolution string
Resolution of the dataset.
from string
example: 2024-08-01 00:00:00
Start of the issue, in YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS format.
to string
example: 2024-08-02 00:00:00
End of the issue, in YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS format.
status string Enum
Status of the issue. Options : ['In queue', 'In progress', 'Waiting Review', 'Waiting for Data Vendor', 'Resolved', 'Closed', 'Cannot Be Resolved']
corruptedFile integer
1 if the issue reports corrupted files, otherwise 0.
missingPoints integer
1 if the issue reports missing data points, otherwise 0.
missingFile integer
1 if the issue reports missing files, otherwise 0.
wrongValues integer
1 if the issue reports wrong values, otherwise 0.
listingError integer
1 if the issue reports a listing error, otherwise 0.
splitError integer
1 if the issue reports a split error, otherwise 0.
dividendError integer
1 if the issue reports a dividend error, otherwise 0.
mappingError integer
1 if the issue reports a ticker mapping error, otherwise 0.
reported integer
Unix timestamp of when the issue was reported.
subscribed boolean
True if you're subscribed to the issue.
userName string
Name of the member who reported the issue.
userPublicId string
Public Id of the member who reported the issue.
userProfile string
URL of the profile image of the member who reported the issue.
Example 
{
  "discussionId": 0,
  "ticker": "string",
  "security": "string",
  "market": "string",
  "resolution": "string",
  "from": "2024-08-01 00:00:00",
  "to": "2024-08-02 00:00:00",
  "status": "In queue",
  "corruptedFile": 0,
  "missingPoints": 0,
  "missingFile": 0,
  "wrongValues": 0,
  "listingError": 0,
  "splitError": 0,
  "dividendError": 0,
  "mappingError": 0,
  "reported": 0,
  "subscribed": true,
  "userName": "string",
  "userPublicId": "string",
  "userProfile": "string"
}

401 Authentication Error

UnauthorizedError Model - Unauthorized response from the API. Key is missing, invalid, or timestamp is too old for hash.
www_authenticate string
Header
